description: Where each oresoftware/* Zed package is published. Read by zed-cli over raw.githubusercontent.com when the registry origin is unavailable, so a package whose repository is not named after it stays resolvable from github.com alone. An entry only locates a repository: the committed .zpkg.toml there must still self-claim the package, so an incorrect entry cannot hijack a name.

next-loggers.note: Canonical development is the polyglot ores.otel.log repository; a repository name containing dots is not a valid package slug.
